item.text: The server already has startup deduplication and a unique name index, so identical database rows should not survive a successful current startup. The list renderer can still duplicate rows when two asynchronous renders overlap: each clears the list, then both append their fetched results. I’m making rendering atomic and adding a consistency guard so overlapping filter refreshes cannot produce duplicate visible rows.
